signals.observation: Students asked the Course Agent for complete working code for a weekly build instead of help understanding their own agent loop.
Weekly feedback marked the failure-case documentation checklist item as missing.
Students asked staff which learning goal a weekly build was meant to exercise.
Students asked what GRPO is ahead of the week 11 session.
Final project proposals presented in week 8 have an empty or one-line evaluation section, with five weeks left before final presentations.
Week 10 single-agent versus multi-agent submissions reported the multi-agent result without running the single-agent baseline on the same tasks.
Students asked staff whether anyone else was working on a similar final project; several memory-agent projects exist whose authors have not seen one another's weekly builds.
Final project plans do not draw on results from the student's own earlier weekly builds, such as a week 7 memory ablation relevant to a memory-based project.
